content.value: Draw a stereographic projection of a cubic crystal on (110), (010), (001) planes. If the cubic crystal plane (111) shares a zone with plane (110) and (001). Then plot (111) plane on this stereographic projection and calculate the angle between 110 and 111 stereographic poles.
